an4.60:1.1: athakho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an4.60:2.1: catūhi kho gahapati dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako gihisāmīcipaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yasapaṭilābhiniṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ
an4.60:2.3: idha gahapati ariyasāvako bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paccupaṭṭhito hoti cīvarena bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paccupaṭṭhito hoti piṇḍapātena bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paccupaṭṭhito hoti senāsanena bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paccupaṭṭhito hoti gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārena.
an4.60:2.4: imehi kho gahapati catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako gihisāmīcipaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yasapaṭilābhiniṃ saggasaṃvattanikanti.
